text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether to enter the Kikuka Sho or pivot 
to another race. Before deciding, there 
was a heated argument.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to run the Kikuka Sho! Since 
Teio can't run, Turbo has no choice but to 
step up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If I don't, everyone will be in trouble 
without a goal to strive for.
choice_data_list:
No, it might be better to switch to local 
races in Fukushima...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we want to play it safe, we should go 
for the graded race in Fukushima. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You really don't wanna do the Kikuka Sho 
no matter what? Then Turbo has a plan of 
her own!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh, no no nooo! If it's not the 
Kikuka Sho, I don't waaant it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deciding factor—her throwing a 
tantrum. In the end, I decided to take on 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The powerhouse Umamusume of that 
generation gather all in one place. And 
among them—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've finally reached it...! The Classic 
Triple Crown I've dreamed of! However—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Teio, who once fired me up and guided me 
along, is no longer here..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I decided I wouldn't get depressed... 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Will people always say that? No matter how 
much I run, will they still say, 'If only 
Teio had raced'?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Nature! How're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, do your best today and keep up with 
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, or I'll leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo... you...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't you feel anything at all? About Teio 
not being here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio is??? Gone???

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? I've known 
that for ages. Did you think I forgot?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean~. I'm asking if you 
aren't curious!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You don't mind, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Of course it won't end up like that. Since 
they aren't here today anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, it's true they aren't here, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, Turbo has something she 
wants to do today!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
3,000m is super long, isn't it? But 
Turbo's not scared at all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Burning, blazing, running and running and 
running my heart out! And then!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll burn out completely! Giving it 
everything I've got, like never before!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo will show you a race only Turbo can 
run. Right here in this Kikuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo... you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An autumn breeze that swept away the 
mood—blew through the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's true. What matters isn't 
what Teio does.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: To run my own race! I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup, bring it on, Nature! If we don't go 
all out, running won't be any fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo explosion!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you must not waver, lose sight of 
your own running, or run a race you'll 
regret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo entered the gate with her usual 
carefree innocence.
